annotation.evidence_span: incrementing the packet sequence number by an externally unpredictable value
annotation.interpretation_a: The packet sequence number is incremented by a value that is unpredictable to an attacker observing network traffic, but predictable to the client and server.
annotation.interpretation_b: The packet sequence number is incremented by a cryptographically random value, ensuring complete unpredictability even to the client and server.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'externally unpredictable value' is underspecified. It could mean a value unpredictable to an external observer (e.g., an attacker) but known to the endpoints, or it could mean a truly random value. These two interpretations lead to different implementations and security properties.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'externally unpredictable value' is not precise. It is unclear whether the value needs to be predictable to the endpoints or truly random.
